summary: Full bug hunt across NeXify AI preview (backend + frontend, DE/NL). 10/10 backend pytest cases pass, all 17 static pages load at desktop 1920px and mobile 390px with no horizontal overflow, all listed review-request flows work end-to-end. No blocking bugs found; main-agent's iteration-4 fixes verified.
critical_code_review_comments: Chat streaming markdown: during streaming, partial ** tokens temporarily render as literal '**' until the closing pair arrives. Final rendered message uses <strong> correctly (3 <strong> nodes in the tested reply). Not a bug, but if visual polish matters, mid-stream buffering of un-terminated markdown would improve UX.

Offer button 'offer-open-btn' appeared only after 4 user messages (fallback path messages.filter.length >= 4). The review-request wording says '2-3 discovery answers', so the LLM 'offerReady' signal apparently was not raised for the tested prompts (Bäckerei/Onlineshop/Budget). Consider tuning the offerReady classifier to fire earlier when a concrete offer scope is expressed.

site-header CTA uses '!hidden md:!inline-flex' - works but relies on '!important' Tailwind overrides. Slightly fragile; consider adding 'hidden md:inline-flex' as regular classes if the underlying btn-primary doesn't force display.
ChatMarkdown regex only supports **bold** and `code` inline; italics (*x*), links [txt](url), and headings (# H) are dropped. Fine for the current LLM prompt, worth documenting.
Cookie consent: banner correctly disappears after 'Alle akzeptieren' and stays gone across reloads.
test_credentials: Admin mail@nexifyai.cloud / 1def!xO2022!! used for /api/auth/login + /admin cockpit access. Kept /admin session read-only.
seed_data_creation: 1 contact lead created via POST /api/contact (name TEST_Iter5, email test@example.com) as required by the /api/contact review case. No offer submissions or bookings written.
context_for_next_testing_agent: BASE_URL: https://rebranding-hub-2.preview.emergentagent.com. Regression file /app/backend/tests/test_iter5_bughunt.py covers the review-request booking 400/409 behaviour and admin cockpit auth. Playwright note: on the /login page, .fill() sometimes doesn't stick to React state race — use press_sequentially() with small delay instead (see iter3 note). Legal-page NL switch takes >=1.5s to re-render — wait accordingly. Admin cockpit panels use various data-testids (admin-stats found; admin-leads/offers/tickets use different naming). Cloudflare rate-limits rapid page tours (429 'Performing security verification') so throttle GETs. Offer button appeared after 4 chat messages, not 2-3 as spec suggests.
rca of the issue: No user-visible bug reproduced. Booking validation: /api/booking/book with slot_id='not-a-uuid' returns 400 via app.exception_handler(ValueError) (checks 'UUID' in str(exc)); with a valid non-existent UUID it returns 409 from the SQL UPDATE ... RETURNING no-row path. UUID handler at /app/backend/server.py:580-585 is correctly ordered before default 500. Mobile header CTA is properly gated via '!hidden md:!inline-flex' and mobile-menu-toggle shows only <lg (site-header.tsx:102, 107). ChatMarkdown wraps assistant messages and yields real <strong> nodes (3 in the test reply). Cookie consent persists via localStorage; /konto → /login redirect confirmed. Static pages: all 17 return 200 with no horizontal overflow at desktop 1920 and mobile 390. pascal.png loads (380x516) on /ueber-mich. Legal DE→NL switch renders localized content (Colofon/JURIDISCH) after ~1.5s. No further action needed.
